name: Airex T92.60 PET foam (core only)
note: Airex T92.60: density 65 kg/m3; shear modulus 15 N/mm2 parallel to the welding lines and 14 and 12 N/mm2 across them; the record holds 14. Its stiffness in its own plane is not published, so it is a core only.
